title: INDEC: October inflation accelerates to 2.2% monthly, 33.1% year-on-year
detail: INDEC reported October 2026 consumer prices rose 2.2% month-on-month (up from 1.9% in September and above the central bank's REM expectation of 1.8%). Year-on-year inflation eased to 33.1% and cumulative 2026 inflation reached 26.3%. Housing, water, electricity and gas posted the largest monthly rise (4.2%); the Pampeana region was highest at 2.6%.
